C0943.title: “Take on debt, get paid millions”? No tolerance for ‘professional debtors’!
C0943.summary: Unscrupulous intermediaries have recently been recruiting so-called professional debtors under the slogan “take on debt, get paid millions,” raising public concern. These individuals assume debt on behalf of others for a fee, willingly becoming long-term debtors or even blacklisted defaulters in exchange for high payouts.
